name: TN Longitudinal (TN-NoDEC)
author: xpilot
description: Replaces SP's longitudinal plan with the TN-NoDEC planner. The card plugin also reads Tesla STW_ACTN_RQ.DTR_Dist_Rq from the right scroll wheel and the planner applies seven t_follow levels (1.05..2.10 s). Prebuilt acados solvers: installs only on the platform it was built for. TN's stopping policy in controlsd is not included.

ExtTnLongTuning.note: TN runtime tuning config (schema v2); absent = TN defaults

ExtTnScrollLevel.note: Right-scroll follow level 0..6; -1 = normal TN personality tuning

ExtTnFollowApplied.note: Diagnostic: applied TN t_follow in milliseconds; -1 = normal tuning
